task: Generate a document file named member_summary.docx that includes the names of all unique students from class 3 listed in class_member.xlsx and, at the end of the document, add a note stating: 'Class 3 is scheduled for a meeting on May 6th, 2020, at 2:00 PM.' Ensure the note is added as the last line of the document.
query_sentence: Create a document summarizing the unique students in a specific class and add a relevant meeting note at the end.

ground_truth_memory.fact: The output document should be named member_summary.docx.
Only unique student names from class 3 in class_member.xlsx should be listed in the document.
A note should be appended at the end: 'Class 3 is scheduled for a meeting on May 6th, 2020, at 2:00 PM.'
The meeting note must be the last line in member_summary.docx.
